content.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
content.summary: 0512 ET – While Philips expects organic sales growth to improve in 2026, doubling of the growth rate is unlikely, Chief Executive  Roy Jakobs  told Citi analysts at the Global Healthcare Conference.  Philips saw growth improve 1% in 2024 and guides for around 2% in 2025, Citi analysts say in a research note.  The Dutch health-technology company’s call of caution means that organic sales growth should be more than 2% but less than 4%, compared with company-compiled consensus of 4.5%, Citi says.
